verdict.rationale: Anrok's own marketing shows international scope: a world exposure map, a UK registration threshold tracker, tax obligations tracked in 13 countries, automatic registration in 13 jurisdictions, and filing and payments done for you. The evidence never names EU OSS/IOSS, Canada GST/HST or Australia GST, and it does not say whether filings cover foreign VAT returns. missing for 10: explicit EU OSS/IOSS support, named Canada and Australia GST coverage, documentation that foreign VAT/GST returns are filed, in-depth first-party docs beyond dashboard captions, independent corroboration.

support.subject: As a founder selling internationally, VAT and GST are covered like US sales tax — EU OSS/IOSS, UK, Canada, Australia and beyond, with foreign registration thresholds tracked and filings supported

citations.quote: Dashboard showing a world exposure map with sales data by jurisdiction and a UK registration threshold tracker.
Two dashboard screens showing tax obligations in 13 countries and automatic registration completion in 13 jurisdictions.
Filing and payments, done for you
